objective: Add exactly one int_to_bytes boundary case to the existing parametrized round-trip test in tests/test_itsdangerous/test_encoding.py.
rationale: The current test covers zero, a one-byte interior value, and the maximum unsigned 64-bit value, but not the first value that requires two encoded bytes. Decimal 256 is the one-to-two-byte length transition and has the exact minimal big-endian representation b"\x01\x00".
